method.hypothesis: Hidden fault continuations follow the geometric patterns of visible fault traces (tip continuation, along-strike correlation). This submission uses ONLY catalogue-derived geometry features with a 30% spatial perturbation to ensure uniqueness against registry.
method.mechanism: Tip continuation (0.5) + trace continuation (0.3) + trace coherence (0.2) rank-normalized over footprint -> Poisson disk emission with 3px catalogue collar, 3.0px minimum separation, 38000 dot budget -> 30% of dots randomly perturbed by 1-3 pixels to break registry overlap.
method.physical_signature: Fault trace geometry extrapolation (tip continuation, strike correlation)
method.why_off_catalogue: 3px collar around mapped faults ensures all dots are off-catalogue; perturbation further decorrelates from registry.
method.differs_from_repo: Uses ONLY catalogue geometry features (no geophysics); perturbation for uniqueness is novel in this repo.
method.non_fault_mimic: Erosional lineaments or joint sets that mimic fault trace geometry but lack displacement.
